I added `clever k8s update <cluster-id|cluster-name>`. `npm run validate` passes (lint, format, types, docs check). I didn't run the command against a real cluster, so it hasn't been tried against the API. It also hasn't been committed.

It takes these options:
- `--name` and `--description` set those two fields.
- `--tag` replaces all the existing tags.
- `--enable-autoscaling` and `--disable-autoscaling` turn the cluster autoscaler on or off. They follow the `enable-`/`disable-` pattern from `config update`, and passing both is an error.
- `--org` picks the organisation.

If no setting is given, it fails with "No setting to update". On success it prints a confirmation with the cluster name and ID.

The command is in `src/commands/k8s/k8s.update.command.js` and uses the `k8sUpdate` helper that was already in `src/lib/k8s.js`. It's registered in `global.commands.js` with `since: null`. I added an "Update a Cluster" section to `docs/kubernetes.md`, and `npm run docs` regenerated `k8s.docs.md` and the skill reference.

Persistent storage isn't an option here because it can't be removed once added, and `add-persistent-storage` already covers it.

`node_modules` was missing, so I ran `npm ci` first. `fix-all` also reformatted `.claude/settings.json`, which has nothing to do with this change, so I reverted it.
